macOS не уведомляет об изменениях буфера: macOS doesn’t report clipboard changes, so the app periodically compares the change counter. The check is very cheap; a shorter interval means faster response.

История буфера обмена: текст, ссылки, фо: Clipboard history: text, links, rich text, images, and files.
История хранится локально: ~/Library/App: History is stored locally: ~/Library/Application Support/Mac Utilities/ClipboardHistory. Data isn’t separately encrypted (it’s protected by FileVault disk encryption, if enabled) and is never sent anywhere.
История хранится только в памяти и исчез: History is kept in memory only and will be lost when you quit. Files on disk have been deleted.
Как Win+V в Windows: щелчок или ↩ сразу: Like Win+V in Windows: a click or ↩ pastes the item into the active window immediately (sends ⌘V). ⇧↩ or the “Copy” button only puts the item on the clipboard. Pasting depends on the target app: secure input fields don’t accept it.
Как в Windows: закрыли последнее окно кр: Like Windows: close the last window with the red button or ⌘W and the app quits. The app will offer to save unsaved documents itself. If the app has windows on another desktop or minimized windows, it doesn’t quit.
Как это работает: приложение следит за D: How it works: the app watches the Dock via Accessibility and shows its own panel next to the icon. The system Dock isn’t modified or replaced — third-party apps can’t integrate into it. With Dock auto-hide and magnification, the panel is positioned at the icon’s actual location.
Кнопки на миниатюрах в превью Dock и пер: Buttons on thumbnails in Dock Preview and Window Switcher: ✕ closes only that window, ⏻ quits the app with all its windows right away. If it’s the last window, ✕ turns orange — the app will quit after closing it.
Кнопки на миниатюре: − свернуть окно, ⏻: Thumbnail buttons: − minimize window, ⏻ quit the app with all its windows, ✕ close only this window. An orange ✕ means it’s the last window and “Auto Quit” is on: the app will quit after closing it.
Копирует путь в буфер обмена: Copies the path to the clipboard
Куда сохранять снимки, выбирается в сист: Where screenshots are saved is set in the system tool: ⌘⇧5 → “Options” → “Save to” → “Other Location…” (for example, Documents → Screenshots). There, also turn off “Show Floating Thumbnail”: while it’s visible (~5 s), macOS doesn’t save the file, so the screenshot reaches the clipboard late. Mac Utilities picks up screenshots both on the Desktop and in “Documents/Screenshots”.
Лимит действует на незакреплённые элемен: The limit applies to unpinned items: when it’s exceeded, the least recently used ones are removed. Pinned items are never removed by the limit, the retention period, or the Trash button in the panel. Copying the same content again doesn’t create a duplicate — the item moves to the top.
